description: source remove through the CLI (k114): a name the target config does not declare exits 1 before anything else, --force or not, naming that config and where else the name is declared – the other scope's config, skilletor.local.json, both, or nowhere – nothing written, no sync; --project with the home as project dir has no project scope; a source with installed items exits 1 without --force. An unused source is removed and the sync after it runs (its report, or `removed source <name>` when it has nothing to say); the file is rewritten as 2-space JSON in its own key order. With --force a used source goes too and the sync stops at the install left without it: exit 2, the edit saved and named (k103).
